name: 本地抠图
description: 抠图：本地算法（魔术棒按颜色选区、擦除/恢复笔刷、收缩与羽化）+ 可选「AI 一键抠图」（本机 ComfyUI 的 BiRefNet 软边基底，经主进程代理调用）。输出带 alpha 的 PNG 并原地替换图片（committed 历史可撤销）。AI 不可用时纯前端离线可用。

descriptionI18n.en: Cutout: local algorithms (magic-wand color selection, erase/restore brushes, shrink and feather) plus an optional "AI one-click cutout" (BiRefNet soft-edge matting on the local ComfyUI, proxied through the main process). Writes alpha PNGs and replaces images in place, revertible through committed history. Fully offline when AI is unavailable.

author: Artflow
